title: Why You Cannot Pay for Your Evolution (1980-07-18)
description:
Are you confused by the overwhelming number of spiritual paths and gurus today? Discover the simple test to distinguish truth from deception and experience actual transformation.

Shri Mataji addresses the confusion of the modern spiritual marketplace, contrasting 'unauthorized' false gurus with the spontaneous nature of true evolution. She explains the physiology of the subtle system, the dangers of occult practices, and engages in a lively Q&A session covering the definition of enlightenment, the Bhagavad Gita, and how to verify a realized soul.

Key Topics:
• ⚡ Why true spiritual evolution is spontaneous, free, and cannot be purchased with money
• 👁️ How to diagnose physical and emotional problems using vibrational awareness on your fingertips
• 💬 Q&A insights on the true meaning of enlightenment and distinguishing real spirituality from fake
• 🌙 Exposing the dangers of black magic and false gurus who promise levitation or physical feats
• 🧠 The surprising connection between overthinking, the liver, and right-sided energy imbalances

“When there is enlightenment within you, your priorities change and you become a master of yourself, absolutely a master. You are no more enslaved by anything, nothing can guide you.”
— Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi

Audience Questions:
• What is enlightenment?
• How can you make out a Realized soul?
• Does the Spirit have a form?
• Is Kundalini really the spiritual thing?
• How can I raise the Kundalini?

Common Questions About Spiritual Awakening:
• How does overthinking affect the liver and health?
• How to protect yourself from false spiritual teachers?
• What are the signs of a true spiritual master?

Shri Mataji mentions that modern times are full of confusion for seekers. What has been your biggest challenge in finding a genuine spiritual path?

Archival audio recording of H.H. Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi at Sahaja Yoga Public Program 1980 in Brighton (England).
